cmd.description: The command to run inside the namespace. If empty, uses $SHELL.

iface_prefix.description: Prefix for virtual interface names (e.g., vde0, vde1 or eth0, eth1).

multi_mode.description: Enable multi-network mode (--multi), creating one interface per network.

resolv_conf.description: Path to a resolv.conf file to mount inside the namespace.

use_clone.description: Force use of clone(2) for namespace creation.

use_sysadm.description: Grant CAP_SYS_ADMIN capability for bind mounts.

vde_networks.description: List of VDE network socket paths to connect to. e.g. ["/var/run/vde.ctl"]
